name: Outdoor Boys
description: Me and my boys, Tommy, Nate and Jacob are the Outdoor Boys. We love all things outdoors: family projects and adventures, travel, forging, camping, camp fire cooking, fossil hunting, magnet fishing, metal detecting, goofing around whatever we darn-well feel like!!

videos.title: Whittier Tunnel - gorgeous drive to Whittier Alaska
videos.overview: The tunnel to Whittier is called the Anton Anderson Memorial Tunnel or just the Whittier tunnel. The tunnel is the second longest highway tunnel in North America and it goes under Maynard Mountain  13,300 ft (4,100 m). The tunnel is 2.5 miles long and it is one lane. Sharing both direction with a railroad as well.

videos.title: How to remove a tick the easy way. Tick Key Review - Tick Remover review.
videos.overview: In Virginia, getting ticks is just part of life when you love the outdoors . There are a lot of myths about how to remove ticks. Removing a ticks isn't painful or complicated and you don't need any special tools. I video taped this tick removal and demonstrated a Tick Key.

videos.title: Kayak and Canoe safety: How to get in a swamped kayak or canoe
videos.overview: If you fall out of a kayak or canoe can you get back in unassisted. Well you sure can, but only if you know how. videos.title: Restoring antique axe - repairing an ax - Making an ax handle and sheath.
videos.overview: Restoring this rusted antique axe head took me about two weeks and about 30 hours. Cleaning and repairing and polishing the axe head, carving, shaping and sanding the axe handle. Making an axe sheath from scratch. This is the entire ax restoration process. I made the handle from Morado hardwood. and the I amde the sheath from waxed harness leather.

videos.title: How to build a fire!! Best fire starter, fire safety & a one-match campfire in the rain

videos.title: 10 BEST Campfire snacks!!!! Camping foods and Campfire Cooking.

Roasted Strawberries, Roasted Starbursts, Cinnamon Rolls on a stick, Baked Apple, and Kettle Corn, Nutella smores, campfire cherros, campfire doughnuts, campfire bannana split and baked yams.

videos.title: How to build a fire in a RAIN STORM! - Survival tips and hacks. Build a campfire in the rain
videos.overview: In  this video I demonstrate how to build a fire in the rain and it was POURING RAIN and blasting lightning!!!  You can light a campfire in the wettest conditions with wet wood as long as you have enough kindling, dry tinder and a way to fan the fire.  This is a very important survival skill to have, and this video includes some survival hacks and techniques. If you would like to learn more about how to build a fire and my techniques check out my video on how to build a fire

videos.title: Berry picking and foraging - Survival food: Autumn olives - How to make Autumn olive jelly.
videos.overview: Foraging for wild berries is one of my favorite things to do in the fall but it is also a great survival food. One of the most plentiful wild berries on the east coast is the Autumn olive berry. They are invasive and grown in massive clumps that make them super easy to harvest in large quantities in the fall. My boys and I harvested 27 lbs of berries in about 2 hours. In this video I show how to make Autumn olive jelly - and even what not to do when making autumn olive jelly.

videos.overview: The Alpine Butterfly Knot (the Alpine Butterfly loop and Alpine Butterfly bend) is one of the most useful knots to know for arborist, camping, climbing, hiking, and survival. It has many uses and this video explains 3 ways to tie the alpine butterfly knot. The twist method, and two hand methods for tying the Alpine Butterfly.

videos.title: Catch & Cook Snake - Hunting Burmese Pythons by Hand
videos.overview: This is one of the most amazing experiences I have ever filmed. I got to hunt invasive Burmese Pythons with licenses python hunter Mike Kimmel at night, by hand in the Florida Everglades. Burmese Pythons are in an invasive species in Florida. After Hurricane Andrew hit Florida dozens of pythons escaped into the swamp and started breeding. Growing over 20 feet long and over 200 lbs these snakes are big and they are having a huge impact on Florida's unique ecosystem. The government has licensed a select few private snake hunters to try and remove as many pythons as possible. I got to ride along with one of these snake hunters and catch my own Burmese Python by hand, at night, in the swamp.

But while the solo camping was comfortable, the return home was very not, my poor car was buried and it took me 3 hrs to dig myself to freedom and only after a lot of help from strangers.

videos.title: Marriage Survival Camping! -22 Degrees with Wife & 3 Kids
videos.overview: My wife can freeze in heat wave. So Can I take her winter camping in Alaska in -22 degree weather and stay happily married. I am going to need the best gear and to cook the best food if I am going to complete the happy wife cold weather camping challenge.

videos.title: Lost in Alaska - How to NOT Freeze to Death! Winter Survival Camping & Bushcraft (No Tent or Bag)
videos.overview: I am winter camping in Alaska without a tent or sleeping bag. I have only 6 items (saw, ferrous rod, knife, billy pot, and spoon) and I am going to show you how to survive even extreme cold comfortably.

videos.title: 4 Days Fishing & Camping in Alaska - Lake Trout Catch & Cook (Catching Every Fish in Alaska)
videos.overview: I want to catch every species of fish in Alaska this Summer so to start I took my boys fishing and camping in the interior of Alaska, ice fishing for burbot, lake trout and white fish. We are also going to catch and cook a lake trout and make salmon candy from lake trout.

videos.title: I Destroyed My Bushcraft Survival Shelter - It Caught Fire
videos.overview: I built a bushcraft shelter with an elevated platform and thatched roof while winter camping in Alaska. I cooked some amazing food and had a great time.

videos.title: 4 Day Fishing + Hunting Catch & Cook in an Inuit Village (Best Ice Fishing in the World)
videos.overview: Me, my son Tommy and my Nephew Ransom are flying into the Arctic Circle to the Inupiaq village of Kotzebue Alaska. We spent 4 days hunting and fishing and getting to experience traditional native Alaskan Inuit culture. We also got to experience what I think is the best ice fishing on earth - the spring sheefish run on the frozen Chukchi sea.

videos.title: 9 Days Fishing & Foraging in Hawaii - Lobster Diving + Spearfishing Catch & Cook
videos.overview: My whole family spent 9 Days in Hawaii, fishing, spearfishing, diving for lobsters, Snorkeling, SCUBA diving, surf fishing, whale watching, eating amazing food, and cooking what we catch. We also got to forage some of the most amazing exotic and tropical fruits.  By The way - the South Family and my good friend Patrick host several family friendly YouTube channels and unfortunately my shout out to him was part of the lost footage.

videos.title: 3 Days Stranded in Alaska's Bear Country - Camping & Foraging Food
videos.overview: A bush plane dropped off Me and my son Jacob  on a remote Alaskan beach  for 3 days. No way home except by plane. And we are camping, exploring, beach combing, foraging food, clam digging and having an amazing adventure together.

videos.title: Camping at -27F/-34C Goes Wrong
videos.overview: Its been a rough week. Me and Jake had a winter camping adventure go wrong. 2 out of 3 of my boys are sick and my wife Rebecca has left me.  I traveled to Wyoming for a change of scenery and that went all wrong too.  But we aren't going to let that stop us from having some fun.

videos.title: Halibut Catch & Cook While Beach Camping in Alaska
videos.overview: We are surf fishing for halibut in Alaska and camping on the beach. Me and my son Jake are eating good food, camping, fishing and having a great time.

videos.title: 18 Day Japan Travel Adventure - Volcanoes, Castles, Fishing & More (Kyushu, Osaka, Kyoto, Hiroshima)
videos.overview: Me and my family, spent 18 days traveling all over Japan. (Fukuoka, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Saga, Takachiho, Aso, Hiroshima, Osaka, Kyoto, Nagaya, & Nara)  We explored Castles, Volcanoes, Hot springs, Went fishing, ate amazing food, got to be ninjas for a day, did Japanese archery, went to baseball games, and did so much more.

videos.title: 8 Days Camping & Building a Bushcraft Survival Shelter with My 5 yr old Son
videos.overview: Me and my 5 yr old son are going winter camping in Alaska and we are not bringing a tent. We are spending the winter building a survival shelter and bushcraft bunk beds to camp.  We are going to be cooking great food, doing bushcraft projects and having a ball.

videos.title: 4 Days Camping, Fishing & Eating What We Catch in Alaska
videos.overview: My Family is taking the ferry from Whittier to Valdez, renting boats, fishing for halibut and rock fish, camping, dip netting for king salmon and Sockeyes and of course we are doing an awesome multi species catch and cook. Its an amazing Alaskan road trip adventure.

videos.title: 24 Tricks to Staying Warm
videos.overview: I have been in some NASTY weather and I have taken my kids in some nasty weather. Here are 24 of my best tips to staying warm. Whether you are camping, skiing, hiking, backpacking or surviving.

videos.title: I Bought an Abandoned Off-Grid Cabin in Alaska (Full of Abandoned Treasures!)
videos.overview: I bought an off-grid cabin on an Abandoned Homestead in remote interior Alaska. Me and my son Tommy, spent 3 days getting to and exploring this remote property and it was full of abandoned treasures.

videos.title: Camping in an Abandoned WWII Army Base in Remote Alaskan Rainforest
videos.overview: Me and my son Tommy, are taking a water taxi to the a remote uninhabited island in Alaska in search of lost WWII army base used to protect Alaska from the Japanese invasion. Remote and rugged, this island is also a temperate rainforest and we hike and climbed our way through dense forest to find this abandoned military base and camp inside.

videos.title: Fishing the Most Dangerous Water in Alaska & Exploring WWII Battlefields
videos.overview: M and my two oldest boys are spending the next 4 days flying to a remote Alaskan island in the Bering Sea to catch tons of fish and explore WWII battlefields. If you want to see out last adventure here at Dutch Harbor  check out  •https://id.420129.xyz/watch?v=WTA-eEkD15U

videos.title: 3 Days Camping, Hiking Glaciers & Exploring Alaska & Yukon
videos.overview: Me and my son Nathan are spending taking a road trip across Alaska into Canada's Yukon territory. Along the way we are hiking glaciers, camping, exploring ice caves, fishing and having fun.

videos.title: My Off Grid Homestead Catches Fire While Building a Bushcraft Road Through Swamp
videos.overview: We bought an abandoned off grid cabin in the interior of Alaska and now we are trying to get a road into our property but there is a lot of swamp that we must cross to do it. So I am building a bushcraft road made from dead timber. But unfortunately life doesn't all ways go as planned and one disaster after another is making homestead life hard.

videos.title: 5 Days Fishing & Camping in Alaska - Cooking What We Catch
videos.overview: We are spending 5 days camping and fishing and eating amazing food. We spent the first night camping on the Talkeetna river fishing for salmon and cooking our fish on the banks of the river. Then we went south and caught more salmon and camped with the entire family.

videos.title: 3 Days Shrimping, Fishing & Camping Alaska
videos.overview: Me and my son Nathan rented a boat and are cruising the waters off Alaska's coast fishing, camping, shrimping and exploring the islands off Alaska. We rented our boat from Whittier Boat Rental's alaska-boat-rentals.com/

videos.title: 4 Days Alone in Alaska - Bushcraft Camping & Foraging Food
videos.overview: I am spending 4 days solo camping in a hot tent bushcraft shelter. I fishing for my food, sea kayaking, hiking, exploring glaciers and baking bread in a bushcraft oven.

videos.title: 4 Days Swamp Foraging with My Family - Frogs, Fishing, Sharks, Crabs & More!
videos.overview: My family is camping in the swamps of Louisiana: Crabbing, fishing, spear fishing, frogging, catching and cooking and having a wonderful Cajun experience.

videos.title: 3 Days Camping & Foraging in Arctic - Fishing, Hunting & Edible Plants
videos.overview: The Alaskan tundra is harsh and beautiful. Whether its clouds of bugs, extreme weather or packs of hungry wolves. I spent 3 days camping and foraging food in the Arctic tundra. Fishing for grayling, hunting ptarmigan and picking berries.

videos.title: Salvaging an Abandoned Off Grid Homestead in Alaska
videos.overview: I bought an abandoned off grid cabin and homestead in Alaska. I am racing to try and make it liveable before winter. I am dealing with cabin fires, building roads through swamps and just trying to fix things faster than they break.

videos.title: Camping in an Alaskan Survival Cabin
videos.overview: My 3 day fall hike in Alaska's mountains hit a snag with a snow storm in mid September. I got soaked through and frozen with a foot of snow falling around me. I had to take shelter in an off grid mountain cabin and try to get my body heat back.

videos.title: 4 Days Solo Camping on Island Full of Whale Bones & Grizzly Bears
videos.overview: I flew to a remote Island in the Gulf Alaska and camped for 4 days in an Off-Grid Cabin. The Island is full of grizzly bears, deer and whale bones. I spent the time hunting, cooking good food and beach combing.

videos.title: Stranded in Alaska's Rainforest - 3 Days Solo camping
videos.overview: I spent 3 days solo camping in Alaska's remote rainforests and mountains. Unfortunately, on the morning of the 3rd day my float pane didn't arrive.

videos.title: Camping at Abandoned Alaskan Homestead with Modified Off-Road Kei Truck
videos.overview: 3 months ago I bought an abandoned off grid cabin and homestead in the heart of Alaska. And for 3 months I have been battling cabin fires, broken equipment and struggling to build a road through the swamp. But our time is up and winter is around the corner and we have to hurry before the snow comes.

videos.title: Bushcraft Shelter Camping Under Northern Lights (Best Campfire Meal Ever!)
videos.overview: I got no tent and no tarp and its getting really cold, but my bush craft shelter allowed me to sleep under some amazing northern lights displays. And I made my new favorite campfire meal.

videos.title: 4 Days Camping, Hunting & Searching for Plane Crash in Alaska's Rainforest
videos.overview: For 4 days, Me and my son Nathan are flying to the remote community of Gustavus Alaska to camp in the bitter cold, hunt for ducks and search for a USAF DC-3 that crashed in the woods.

videos.title: Winter Camping in Remote Survival Cabin
videos.overview: High in Alaska's mountains there are a chain of survival cabins hidden between glaciers and peaks. I hiked through waist deep snow and crossed a glacier to get to one.

videos.title: Bushcraft Camping with Coyotes & Hunting My Dinner
videos.overview: Sometimes I camp without any gear because I want to challenge myself. Sometimes I camp without gear because I did a terrible job packing. But on this trip, I did a solo bushcraft camping trip and hunted grouse and rabbits for my dinner....Oh and I woke up surrounded by a pack of coyotes.

videos.title: 6 Days on a Remote Tropical Island
videos.overview: I took my wife to a remote tropical island for 6 days without telling her. We are spearfishing, diving, and eating amazing food.

videos.title: Winter Storms Crush My Off Grid Homestead
videos.overview: This summer I bought an abandoned off gird homestead in Alaska. I was full of abandoned equipment, ATV, tools and buildings. Since them I have been vlogging my efforts to salvage this homestead and make it something my family can enjoy. But now, winter is here and the first storms have already taken a toll on us.

videos.title: 22 Miles (35 km) in a Blizzard Without a Tent - Solo Camping in Survival Shelters
videos.overview:

Makes joke about his wife liking tall, corky Christmas trees.

videos.title: 3 Days in Arctic with Bushcraft Hot Tent & No Sleeping Bag
videos.overview: I am in the Taiga forests of Alaska, winter camping with no tent and no sleeping bag. I am building a bushcraft survival shelter and hot tent and camping for 3 days.

videos.title: Camping Under the Snow in Survival Shelter
videos.overview: I am in the mountains of Alaska and the snow is deep. over 6 feet (2 meters) in places and the winter has only just started. I am building a winter survival shelter and camping under the snow. I am snow shoeing and back country skiing and cooking good food.

videos.title: 14 Days Hunting, Fishing & Crabbing Florida
videos.overview: For 2 weeks we are exploring Florida's everglades, remote islands, and beautiful keys. Hunting alligators, catching pythons, crabbing, raking oysters, fishing, spear fishing, scuba diving, meeting up with friends and more.

videos.title: 4 Days Camping in Alaska at -23 Degrees
videos.overview: I am traveling many miles into the Alaskan bush with my snowmachine and hot tent for 4 days. I'll be hunting, fishing, camping, and all completely solo.

videos.title: Camping in Alaska's Deepest Snow with a Dugout Survival Shelter
videos.overview: I am traveling to Juneau Alaska to camp in the deepest snow in Alaska. I am building a snow cave which is a winter time dugout survival shelter.

videos.title: Stranded on 120 yr Old Off-Grid Homestead (4 Days Hunting, Fishing & Exploring)
videos.overview: I am attempting to snowmobile 120 miles into the Alaskan wilderness to reach the oldest lodge in Alaska. This off-grid homestead was settled in 1904 and for the next 4 days me and the family are going to hunt ptarmigan, ice fish, snow machine, ski, sled, and explore.

videos.title: 10 Day Hawaii Adventure - Cooking Feral Pigs & Polynesian Survival Skills
videos.overview: My family is traveling to the Island of Oahu for 10 days of outdoor adventure. We are going to be trapping and cooking feral pigs in a Hawaiian imu, throwing a backyard Hawaiian luau with old friends, learning about Polynesian culture and survival skills and eating amazing food.

videos.title: 4 Days in the Arctic - Crabbing, Hunting & Fishing Alaska
videos.overview: Me and my son Nathan are traveling the far North of Alaska to explore the Arctic. We are catching King Crab through the frozen sea ice, Ice fishing for cod, Hunting ptarmigan, dog mushing, snow machining, learning about Inuit culture and exploring Alaska. We are going to Nome Alaska.

videos.title: 3 Days Camping, Hunting and Mushing in the Arctic
videos.overview: I drove 32 hrs to Alaska's far north, to traverse the Arctic tundra with my own dog team (Kindly borrowed from Iditarod musher Lauro Ekland)  I will be winter camping in the Arctic Circle in -18 F (-21C), hunting for moose and ptarmigan, and eating amazing food.

videos.title: 7 Days Repairing Off-Grid Cabin in Alaska
videos.overview: Its our first full winter here at the off-grid homestead in Alaska and we are doing a lot of repairs. I am replacing the garage that collapsed under the snow and fixing lots broke and stuck equipment.

videos.title: Camping, Fishing & Clamming in a Snow Storm - Coastal Foraging in Alaska
videos.overview: Me, my son Tommy, and the Kilcher Family are head out for spring adventure in Alaska. But a snow storm is going to make things interesting. We are camping, foraging food, digging clams, fishing for cod, halibut and flounder and having a great time.

videos.title: Camping in Whale Graveyard & Treasure Hunting Remote Alaskan Beaches
videos.overview: I flew the Dillingham Alaska and hire a bush plane to take me to some of Alaska's remotest beaches to search for dead walrus's and walrus ivory. I camped in some amazing places including a beach that is covered in the bones of various whales. I found a ton of amazing stuff including ivory and I am bring you along on my 4 day adventure.

videos.title: Hunting & Camping with Hadza Tribe in Africa - Forging Spears, Foraging Honey & Primitive Survival
videos.overview: My family is traveling to Tanzania to learn primitive survival skills from the tribes of Northern Tanzania. We are going to visit the Datoga people to learn to forge spears and poison arrowheads. Then we are going to camp, hunt, cook, and forage wild honey with the Hadza tribe or Hadzabe.  The Hadza will also demonstrate how they make bows and arrows and survive in Africa's savanna.  Later we will go on a Safari and meet the Masai people and visit a Masai village.

videos.title: 3 Days Camping, Hunting & Fishing on Remote Island in Alaska
videos.overview: Middleton Island is one of the more remote Island in Alaska. No one lives on Middleton Island and only biologists and FAA maintenance crews visit. Me and my boys spent 3 days on this island hunting feral rabbits, surf fishing for neon blue kelp greenling, exploring WWII era shipwrecks and abandoned military bases.

videos.title: 7 Days Remote Camping, Fishing & Exploring Ketchikan Alaska
videos.overview: My family flew to Ketchikan Alaska for 7 days to explore South East Alaska, do remote flyin camping and fly fishing. Rent a boat and fish for rock fish and halibut. Meet native carvers and learn about native Alaska culture and much more.

videos.title: 1 Week Fishing, Camping, & Hiking Adventure ( I Flew a Family of 10 to Alaska)
videos.overview: A widow with 4 kids and a widower with 4 kids just became a family of 10 and my wife and I flew them to Alaska for 1 week for the ultimate Alaska adventure vacation with the Outdoor Boys. We caught salmon, halibut and rock fish, hike to abandoned military bases in the rainforest, camped by the ocean, fed reindeer and took ATVs to my abandoned homestead.

videos.title: 4 Months at Our Off-Grid Cabin & Homestead in Alaska
videos.overview: 1 year ago I bought an off grid homestead and cabin that was full of abandoned property. And we have spent the last 4 months working hard on the property to get repairs and projects done before winter. Summer is a busy time in Alaska, so as soon as the snow starts to melt we got to work on our abandoned homestead. We are finishing our new garage to replace the one that was crushed by the snow. Repairing the cabin that caught on fire last summer. Demolishing an old log cabin. Building roads. Working on ATV's and a lot more. 4 months worth of footage from our first full summer at the off grid cabin.

videos.title: 3 Days Solo Camping, Fishing, Hunting & Foraging Food in Arctic
videos.overview: I am traveling deep into Alaska's interior to spend 3 days hunting, fishing, camping and foraging food. I catch and cook my dinner while the snow piles up on the mountains. Its cold and wet and beautiful. Also some of the best fly fishing ever.

videos.title: 4 Days in Alaskan Yupik Village - Moose Hunting, Fishing & Spearing Seals with Atlatls
videos.overview: I was invited to the Yupik village of Kotlik Alaska by my friend Sam and we spent 4 days hunting and fishing and learning about the Yupik culture. We harvested a moose for to give to patients at the Native hospital in Anchorage Alaska, we hunted seals with the traditional atlatl and spear. Set gill nets, caught salmon and sheefish and learned about Yupik culture.

videos.title: 4 Days Hunting Ducks, Geese & Fishing Nome Alaska
videos.overview: We're flying North to Nome Alaska along the Bering Sea to hunt ducks, geese, swans, ptarmigan, fish for salmon and more. Its a four day adventure in one of my favorite parts of Alaska.

videos.title: 6 Days Jungle Survival Camping with NO Food - US Marine Corps Jungle Survival School
videos.overview: 8 Months ago I found the US Marine Corps Jungle Survival school in Okinawa Japan on Google Maps. So I reached out to the USMC and asked if I could attend the school and film the experience and they said "Yes". Prior to arriving to Okinawa I knew Very Very little about what actually happens at the USMC Jungle Survival school and boy was I in for a surprise.  I was attached with their leadership course, a more rigorous course for team and squad level leaders. Its a 5 week course that teaches repelling and crossing extreme terrain, how to treat and evacuate casualties in the jungle and spends a lot of time on jungle tactics. The fourth week of the training is all about survival in jungle environment. So I joined about 30 marines for survival school portion of their training.

videos.title: Rafting the Ice Flow & Solo Bushcraft Camping in Alaska
videos.overview: I took a helicopter from Talkeetna Alaska to a remote section of river at the base of Mt. Denali. There I set up camp for 3 days of cold weather solo camping and bushcraft. However, when the temperature suddenly dropped well bellow freezing, the river began to freeze up and getting home meant riding a frozen river of ice.

videos.title: Rebuilding Off-Grid Cabin at our Abandoned Homestead (prepping for Alaska's winter)
videos.overview: Last year we bought an off grid Alaskan homestead that was full of abandoned tools and equipment. And soon after, one of the buildings caught fire and almost burned to the ground. We have spent the last year repairing the electrical system, building an all season ATV trail into the property and replacing a collapsed garage and finally its time to build that burned cabin into a proper bunk house. But winter is right around the corner so its a race to get the project done before the extreme snow and cold sets in.

videos.title: No tent, No sleeping bag - Extreme Winter Survival Camping (0F/-18C)
videos.overview: What is wrong with me? I spend way too much money on sleeping bags, insulated mats and hot tents and instead I go off and sleep in the snow with none of it. So yeah, I marched off a couple miles into the hills of Alaska with no tent, no sleeping bag and no tarp. I made a winter survival shelter and demonstrate the best winter time survival shelter if you don't want to freeze to death. It dropped well bellow 0F (-18C) and I cooked moose ribs and baked bread on the coals. Its a fun video so stop reading this and go give it a look.

videos.title: 6 Days in Palau - Searching Jungle for WWII Battlefields, Fishing, Kayaking & Snorkeling
videos.overview: We flew around the world to the island nation of Palau to search the jungle for lost WWII battlefields, Snorkeling crystal clear water, catch and eat fish and kayak through the jungle.

videos.title: 3 Days in Arctic Survival Shelter - Solo Bushcraft Camping & Blacksmithing
videos.overview: Winter has family come, and the muskeg is frozen. So I am taking my tracked kei truck off the beaten path to explore the frozen lakes and swamps of Alaska's interior. I am going to spend 3 days camping with out a tent, sleeping under animal hides in a bushcraft survival shelter. I am going to do some campfire cooking and do a quick bushcraft blacksmithing project around the campfire as well.

videos.title: Exploring Every Island in Hawaii - 9 weeks fishing, camping, hiking, diving & exploring
videos.overview: 3 years ago we made a goal to visit every public island in Hawaii (The big Island, Kauai, Maui, Molokai, Lanai and Oahu). So we spent a total of 9 weeks exploring all 6 islands. We did a lot of fishing, snorkeling, diving, beach combing, camping, hiking, and just meeting the most wonderful people.

videos.title: Rebuilding Off-Grid Cabin & Digging Well at Alaskan Homestead
videos.overview: I bought an abandoned Alaskan homestead and off-grid cabin with no water source or well. For 2 years I have been building roads, repairing buildings, fixing equipment and hauling water onto our property. For the next 3 months we are finishing some major projects and tackling our water problem.

videos.title: 2 Weeks in Taiwan - Hunting Jade, Shrimp Fishing, Indigenous Survival & More
videos.overview: My Family spent 2 weeks traveling Taiwan for the first time. Its a small Island packed full of culture and adventure and amazing food. We got to go shrimp fishing in Taipei and a fishing restaurant, learning about the various indigenous cultures at a survival school in Hualien, Hunting jade in a mountain river, Climbing monkey mountain in Kaohsiung, Celebrating Christmas and New Years with a bang, some unexpected trips to the Hospital and of course we ate amazing food everywhere.

videos.title: Forging a Knife & Survival Camping Alone in the Wilderness
videos.overview: I am heading into the woods of Alaska for 3 days with no sleeping bag or tent. I am going to sleep in a survival shelter, make a forge, make a charcoal kiln, make charcoal, forge and make a knife and do it all in extreme cold weather alone in the wilderness.

videos.title: Camping on Frozen Ocean - 6 Days Fishing for King Crab & Hunting Ptarmigan
videos.overview: The Berring Sea is frozen and I am headed to Nome Alaska to Solo camp on the edge of the ice pack with my hot tent while fishing for giant king crab through the ice. I'll also be hunting for ptarmigan and looking for muskox. And later on my family will join me in Nome.

videos.title: 2 Weeks in Australia - Swimming with Crocodiles, Racing Rally Cars & Petting Kangaroos
videos.overview: This 2 week trip to Australia WAS INSANE!!!! We ate water buffalo in an aboriginal village, swam with salt water crocodiles, caught barramundi, raced rally cars, got introduced to Australian football, landed helicopters on waterfalls, learned to throw boomerangs and play digeridoo, ate tons of lamingtons and meat pies, got to play with baby wallabies and pet kangaroos and so much more. BEST introduction to Australia ever.

videos.title: Camping in Arctic Circle with No Tent (-26 Degrees)
videos.overview: I am 150 miles (241 km) North of the Arctic Circle in Alaska solo camping without a tent in -26 C/-15F. I am crossing desolate frozen tundra, sleeping in snow caves, hunting ptarmigan and caribou and visiting isolated Alaskan communities.

videos.title: Goodbye
videos.overview: In this episode Luke announces that he is going to step away from YouTube. The amount of work and challenges with people recognizing him and his family are getting overwhelming. Tommy's channel, Outdoor Tom, will continue. Luke made the choice to spend more time with his family and help raise his boys to be good members of society. He mentioned he has several videos in the pipeline or half done that he will release all in one batch at the end of the year. For the foreseeable future, this is the end of the channel. Sad day...We will miss you, Luke.

videos.title: 3 Days Camping & Fishing Alaska's Wilderness (Near Dick Proenneke's Cabin)
videos.overview: Me and my 3 boys got dropped off by float plane in Alaska's remote wilderness and we are camping without a tent for 3 days fishing, hiking and rafting Twin Lakes in Lake Clark National Park (Home of the original bushcraft VLOGGER - Dick Proenneke)

videos.title: 4 Days Camping, Hunting for Dead Walrus & Trolling for Bears
videos.overview: For 3 yeas I have wanted to find a set of walrus tusks and this time its finally happening. I am flying to a remote part of western Alaska on the shores of the Bering Sea where I will be camping alone in bear country, hiking, beach combing, searching for shed caribou antlers and hunting for dead walrus ivory.

videos.title: Building an Off Grid Forge on My Alaskan Homestead
videos.overview: Join me for the entire summer, working on my off-grid Alaskan homestead. I am building a blacksmithing forge, building roads, fixing equipment and preparing for winter.
